name: nilyo
description: Use your own LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Email (Gmail, Outlook, IMAP) and Calendar accounts from ChatGPT: search, read, message and act, with account connection and subscription handled in the conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Your own LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Email and Calendar accounts, usable from ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription:
Plugs your LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, your email and your calendar — straight into ChatGPT, so it can act for you.

Reach the right people. Find them on LinkedIn, see who already knows them in your network, turn a profile link into a message that's ready to send, or follow up on WhatsApp. Say "send a WhatsApp to Julien saying I'm running late" and it's gone.

Never miss a reply. Schedule a task and let ChatGPT check your LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email every morning, summarize what came in, flag the messages that still need an answer and draft the replies — you just approve.

One agent, all your channels. Comment post on LinkedIn, Research on Instagram, follow up on WhatsApp, confirm by email, check your calendar — without leaving the chat. Catch up on any inbox, grab the attachment you need, or re-read what you last wrote to someone before answering them.
defaultPrompt: Who do I know at Stripe on LinkedIn?
Open this LinkedIn profile URL and draft a short intro message, then send it once I approve.
Send a WhatsApp to Julien saying I'll be 10 minutes late.
Search my IMAP inbox for the last email from Sarah and summarize it.
Show my LinkedIn conversations that still need a reply.
